## How to verify

<!-- The steps a reviewer should take. Include routes/locales where relevant. -->

- [ ] `bun run lint` and `bun run lint:style` pass
- [ ] `bun run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `bun run test` passes
- [ ] `bun run build` succeeds

## Checklist

- [ ] The commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org)
- [ ] Content changes are accurate in every script they ship in (English, Telugu, Hindi)
- [ ] User-facing strings are translated, not hard-coded
- [ ] SEO-relevant changes keep titles, descriptions and structured data intact
- [ ] `bun run pwa:verify` still passes if this touches the manifest, icons or service worker
